name: Doctrine Feature
summary: Hold Doctrine Feature Hearthguard While you are below half hit points, your armour damage reduction increases by 1. Ironhead Once per short rest, when you damage an object, vehicle, or machine, treat the hit as a critical hit. Guild-Militant When you mark a target with Oath-Mark, allies gain +1 to damage against it until your next turn.
